es: Explicar con condicionales mixtos cómo una decisión pasada cambió tu presente y qué sería distinto, con la razón de cada decisión.

teaching.en: I chose to study art. If I hadn't chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now.
teaching.es: Elegí estudiar arte. Si no hubiera elegido arte, ahora no sería diseñadora.
teaching.explanationEs: Decisión + condicional 3 → 2 sobre lo que serías hoy.
segments: I chose to study art. If I hadn't
chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now.
teaching.audioText: I chose to study art. If I hadn't chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now.

teaching.en: The reason was simple: I wanted to live near my family.
teaching.es: La razón era sencilla: quería vivir cerca de mi familia.
teaching.explanationEs: The reason was… introduce el porqué de la decisión.
segments: The reason was simple: I wanted
teaching.audioText: The reason was simple: I wanted to live near my family.

teaching.en: I'm shy, so I didn't apply for the job. If I were more confident, I would have applied.
teaching.es: Soy tímida, así que no solicité el trabajo. Si fuera más segura, lo habría solicitado.
teaching.explanationEs: Rasgo de hoy (2) + resultado pasado (3): if + were, would have + participio.
segments: I'm shy, so I didn't apply for the job.
If I were more confident, I would have applied.
teaching.audioText: I'm shy, so I didn't apply for the job. If I were more confident, I would have applied.

teaching.en: I took the job; otherwise, I would still be looking for work now.
teaching.es: Acepté el trabajo; de lo contrario, aún estaría buscando empleo.
teaching.explanationEs: Otherwise introduce lo que pasaría de no haber decidido así.
segments: I took the job; otherwise, I would
still be looking for work now.
teaching.audioText: I took the job; otherwise, I would still be looking for work now.

teaching.en: Thanks to that decision, I met Leo. As a result, I'm happier today.
teaching.es: Gracias a esa decisión conocí a Leo. Como resultado, hoy soy más feliz.
teaching.explanationEs: Thanks to + causa; as a result + efecto.
segments: Thanks to that decision, I met Leo.
As a result, I'm happier today.
teaching.audioText: Thanks to that decision, I met Leo. As a result, I'm happier today.

teaching.en: Luckily, I changed my plans, and that's why I live here.
teaching.es: Por suerte cambié mis planes, y por eso vivo aquí.
teaching.explanationEs: Luckily expresa alivio; that's why introduce la consecuencia.
segments: Luckily, I changed my plans, and
teaching.audioText: Luckily, I changed my plans, and that's why I live here.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que une la timidez de hoy de Ana con lo que no hizo.

choices.text: If Ana had been more confident, she would apply.
If Ana were more confident, she would have applied.
If Ana is more confident, she would have applied.

feedback.es: La timidez es de hoy (were) y no solicitar fue pasado (would have applied): dirección 2 → 3.

hint.es: Un rasgo de hoy explica algo que no pasó antes: if + pasado, would have + participio.

origin.text: Ana is shy. She didn't apply for the job last year.

prompt.es: Completa: «Elegí arte. Si no hubiera elegido arte, hoy no sería diseñadora.»

feedback.es: Designer es la profesión que resulta de la decisión; wouldn't be + profesión = resultado presente.

hint.es: Es la profesión de quien trabaja con el arte y el dibujo.

origin.text: I chose art. If I hadn't chosen art, I wouldn't be a ___ now.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Gracias a esa decisión conocí a Leo.»

answer.text: Thanks to that decision, I met Leo.

feedback.es: Thanks to + causa, y después el efecto en pasado simple.

hint.es: Empieza con thanks to y termina con el nombre.

prompt.es: Escribe un condicional mixto sobre esa decisión y su efecto actual.

answer.text: If I hadn't accepted the job, I wouldn't be living in Quito now.
accepted: If I hadn't accepted the job, I wouldn't be living in Quito now.
If I hadn't accepted the job, I wouldn't live in Quito now.
If I had not accepted the job, I would not be living in Quito now.

feedback.es: Decisión pasada en la condición (hadn't accepted) y efecto actual con wouldn't + verbo base y now.

origin.text: Decisión: aceptaste un trabajo en Quito. Hoy vives allí.

prompt.es: Elige el conector que muestra el resultado de esa decisión.

feedback.es: As a result introduce la consecuencia; otherwise habla de lo que pasaría de otro modo.

origin.text: I left my old job. ___, I'm much happier today.

prompt.es: Completa: «Acepté el trabajo; de lo contrario, aún estaría buscando empleo.»

feedback.es: Otherwise significa «de lo contrario» y abre la alternativa que no ocurrió.

origin.text: I took the job. ___, I would still be looking for work now.

prompt.es: Escribe sobre una decisión: razón, efecto actual y un rasgo que explica algo pasado.

answer.text: I chose to study art because I love drawing. If I hadn't chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now. If I were more confident, I would have applied for that job.
accepted: I chose to study art because I love drawing. If I hadn't chosen art, I wouldn't be a designer now. If I were more confident, I would have applied for that job.
I moved to Quito because of my job. If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't have this flat now. If I were braver, I would have moved earlier.
I took the job because I needed money. If I hadn't taken it, I would still be looking for work now. If I were more confident, I would have asked for more.

feedback.es: Una buena respuesta da una razón (because), un condicional 3 → 2 (hadn't… wouldn't) y uno 2 → 3 (were… would have).

origin.text: Escribe sobre una decisión tuya: qué decidiste y por qué, qué sería distinto hoy y qué habrías hecho si fueras más seguro.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué lamenta la hablante.

choices.text: She did not follow her own wish to study music.
She studied music against her parents' wishes.
She became a doctor and is happy.

feedback.es: Lamenta no haber estudiado música; por eso piensa que sería más feliz hoy.

origin.audio: I didn't study music because my parents wanted me to be a doctor. If I had studied music, I would be happier now.

prompt.es: ¿Cuál de estas frases tiene bien formado el efecto actual?

choices.text: If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't have had this job now.
If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't have this job now.
If I wouldn't have moved, I wouldn't have this job now.

feedback.es: Con now el resultado lleva would + verbo base, y la condición pasada lleva hadn't + participio.

prompt.es: Completa las dos condicionales mixtas con la palabra que falta.

feedback.es: El resultado presente pide would + verbo base; el rasgo de hoy en la condición pide weren't.

sentences: If I had saved money, I ___ be able to travel now.
If I ___ so shy, I would have spoken to her.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por suerte tomé ese trabajo, y por eso vivo aquí.»

answer.text: Luckily, I took that job, and that's why I live here.

feedback.es: Luckily expresa alivio y that's why introduce la consecuencia de la decisión.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada conector con su significado.

feedback.es: Estos conectores enlazan la decisión con su suerte, su causa, su efecto o su alternativa.

prompt.es: Leo cometió un error típico: ¿cómo queda bien su frase?

choices.text: If I didn't move, I wouldn't be here now.
If I wouldn't move, I wouldn't be here now.
If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't be here now.

feedback.es: Para hablar de un pasado irreal que explica hoy: hadn't + participio y wouldn't + verbo base.

origin.text: Leo wrote: If I wouldn't have moved, I wouldn't be here now.
